answer: Quartz Delay Registry: each new identity must solve a unique, server-issued proof-of-work puzzle chained to a slowly rotating beacon, and its first 30 actions are throttled to one per epoch. Cloning costs one full puzzle plus 30 epochs of idle capacity per clone, paid before any value accrues. Identities also post a refundable terrace deposit forfeited on duplicate device fingerprints. Basalt anchoring timestamps make backdated registration detectable, so farms can't pre-build identities cheaply.
